name: seller.image.prepareUpload
title: Profile: seller.image.prepareUpload
description: Canonical profile for preparing and registering seller draft images.
text:
# seller.image.prepareUpload

TL;DR:
- The image flow has four steps: pre-sign, external PUT, upload registration, gallery attachment.
- user.s3PreSign does not return an upload id.

This profile is for image preparation before draft gallery or publish steps.
whenToUse: The seller wants to attach images to a draft or listing.
The workflow needs upload ids for gallery attachment or publish.
recommended: Upload binary bytes with an external PUT request.
Call user.uploadCreate with the returned CDN URL.
Attach returned upload ids through seller.draftGalleryCreate or seller.listingCreate.
avoid: Do not treat the CDN URL as an upload id.
Do not call user.uploadCreate before the PUT upload succeeds.
exampleInterpretation: Use url for PUT upload and cdn for user.uploadCreate.
Only the uploadCreate result gives the stable upload id.
